fullDescription: A warm, playful pastel agency-website homepage for a friendly design studio: a cream #fdf9f3 canvas with a coral #ff7a59 / teal #2bb6a3 / sunny-yellow #ffc23c trio on near-black ink #23201d, heavy Poppins type, a sticky glassy nav, a split hero (big headline with a coral 'smile' under a hand-drawn squiggle + a floating bento stat collage), an infinite dark service marquee with outline stroke-text, a colorful 5-card work grid, a services trio, a client logo row, a big coral CTA panel, and a dark 4-column footer. Friendly-maximalist craft: chunky hard-offset ink drop-shadows that press on hover, organic floating blob shapes, and gentle floaty/spin animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, playful pastel agency-website homepage for a friendly design studio. A sticky cream glassy nav (a coral rounded-square sparkle logo with a hard ink drop-shadow, a 'Studio Marmalade' wordmark with 'Marmalade' in coral, four center links, and a dark 'Start a project' pill) sits above a hero that splits a left copy column from a right floating bento collage. The hero copy has a teal pill eyebrow, a huge extrabold Poppins headline 'We make brands people actually smile about.' where 'smile' is coral with a hand-drawn sunny underline squiggle, a soft body line, a coral primary button with a hard ink offset shadow plus an outlined 'Say hello' button, and an overlapping-avatar social-proof row. The right collage is three floating rounded stat cards (teal 240+, sunny 4.9 stars, coral 9 yrs) with a rotated '100% human' badge. Below: a dark ink marquee strip of services (Branding / Web Design / Product UI / Illustration / Motion with asterisks, some words in outline stroke text), a 5-card project grid (3 colored cards, a wide ink campaign card with a spinning blob, and an outlined card) with lift-on-hover, a tinted-teal services trio (three rounded cards, the middle ink one raised) with hard-shadow icon chips and check lists, a centered client logo row of icon+wordmark lockups, a big coral rounded CTA panel with floating blobs and two pill buttons, and a dark four-column footer with social circles. The signature is the friendly maximalist craft: a cream #fdf9f3 canvas, a coral/teal/sunny trio on near-black ink #23201d, organic blob shapes, floaty/spin/marquee animations, and chunky hard-offset (0 8px 0 0 ink) drop-shadows on buttons and chips.

## Estilo Visual
Warm playful pastel agency website. Load Tailwind via CDN and register exact custom colors in tailwind.config: cream #fdf9f3, coral #ff7a59, teal #2bb6a3, sunny #ffc23c, ink #23201d, plus a custom borderRadius blob: '46% 54% 62% 38% / 54% 42% 58% 46%'. body { background:#fdf9f3; color:#23201d; font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased } and html { scroll-behavior:smooth }. The ONLY palette is cream + coral + teal + sunny on ink; never introduce blue/purple/gradient-slop. The signature flourishes, all as small CSS: .blob1 { border-radius:46% 54% 62% 38% / 54% 42% 58% 46% } and .blob2 { border-radius:60% 40% 33% 67% / 50% 56% 44% 50% } (organic floating shapes); @keyframes floaty { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)} } applied as .floaty (7s) and .floaty-slow (10s); @keyframes spin-slow { to{transform:rotate(360deg)} } as .spin-slow (22s linear); @keyframes marquee { from{transform:translateX(0)} to{transform:translateX(-50%)} } as .marquee-track (26s linear); .stroke-text { -webkit-text-stroke:2px #23201d; color:transparent } for outline words; .card-hover { transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .35s } with hover translateY(-8px) rotate(-1deg). The chunky hard-offset shadow is the brand signature: use shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#23201d] (or 0 6px 0 0 on smaller chips) on the coral logo square, the icon chips, and the coral primary button, with hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#23201d] so it presses down. Colored cards get soft colored glow shadows e.g. shadow-[0_18px_36px_-14px_rgba(43,182,163,.65)] (teal) / rgba(255,122,89,.6) (coral). Icons are Iconify Phosphor fill glyphs (ph:sparkle-fill, ph:hand-waving-fill, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:paint-brush-broad-fill, ph:ice-cream-fill, ph:bird-fill, ph:flower-lotus-fill, ph:smiley-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:asterisk-bold, etc) loaded from the Iconify CDN script. body has overflow-x-hidden so the floating blobs never cause horizontal scroll.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glassy nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header with bg-cream/85 backdrop-blur-md and a 1px bottom border in ink/5. Inside: mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8, h-[74px], flex row items-center justify-between. Left = brand lockup: a relative grid place-items-center w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-coral text-cream chip holding a ph:sparkle-fill (20px) with the signature hard shadow shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d], beside the wordmark 'Studio' + 'Marmalade' (the second word in text-coral), text-[19px] font-extrabold tracking-tight. Center (hidden md:flex, gap-9, text-[15px] font-medium text-ink/70): Work / Services / Clients / Contact, each hover:text-ink. Right: a 'Start a project' pill (hidden sm:inline-flex, px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-ink text-cream text-[14px] font-semibold, hover:bg-coral) with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold; plus a md:hidden hamburger button (grid place-items-center w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-ink/5 with a ph:list-bold).

### Hero (split copy + bento collage)
A relative overflow-hidden section. Behind everything, a pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 layer of floating shapes: a w-72 h-72 bg-sunny/45 .blob1 floaty-slow top-left, a w-40 h-40 bg-teal/35 .blob2 floaty top-right, a w-16 h-16 dashed-border-coral/50 rounded-full spin-slow bottom-left, and a small w-6 h-6 bg-coral dot floaty. Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 pt-16 pb-20 -> lg:pt-24 lg:pb-28, a grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center. Left (lg:col-span-7): a rounded-full pill eyebrow (bg-teal/15 text-teal text-[13px] font-semibold) with a ph:hand-waving-fill + 'A friendly design studio'; an H1 font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[0.98] text-[clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5.3rem)] reading 'We make brands people actually smile about.' where 'smile' is a relative inline-block text-coral with an absolute hand-drawn SVG squiggle underline (stroke #ffc23c, stroke-width 7, stroke-linecap round); a max-w-[30rem] text-ink/65 lead; a button row: a coral primary 'See our work' button (px-7 py-4 rounded-full bg-coral text-cream font-semibold, shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#23201d], hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#23201d]) with a ph:arrow-down-bold, plus an outlined 'Say hello' button (bg-cream border-2 border-ink rounded-full, hover:bg-sunny) with a ph:play-circle-fill; then a social-proof row of three overlapping -space-x-3 w-10 h-10 rounded-full avatars (coral/teal/sunny with border-[3px] border-cream and initials) + 'Loved by 120+ founders & product teams worldwide.'. Right (lg:col-span-5, relative): a grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 bento of floating stat cards, each rounded-[2rem] p-7 flex-col justify-between h-44: a full-width col-span-2 teal card (ph:paint-brush-broad-fill, 'Projects shipped 240+', soft teal glow shadow), a sunny card (ph:cursor-click-fill, 'Avg. rating 4.9 stars'), and a coral card (ph:rocket-launch-fill, 'Yrs of craft 9', soft coral glow); plus an absolute -top-7 -right-3 rotate-6 w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-cream border-2 border-ink floaty badge reading '100% human'. All three cards carry .floaty/.floaty-slow.

### Marquee statement strip
A full-bleed bg-ink text-cream py-7 band with an overflow-hidden inner. A .marquee-track flex w-max items-center gap-10 (animation 26s linear infinite) containing TWO identical flex groups (the second aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Each group: the words Branding / Web Design / Product UI / Illustration / Motion at text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap, separated by ph:asterisk-bold icons tinted alternately sunny/coral/teal, with 'Web Design' and 'Illustration' rendered as .stroke-text (transparent fill, 2px cream text-stroke) for contrast against the solid words.

### Project grid
Section id=work, py-20 -> lg:py-28, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. Header row (flex-wrap items-end justify-between): left = a coral uppercase eyebrow 'Now highlights' + an H2 'Recent work we're proud of.'; right = an outlined 'View all projects' pill (border-2 border-ink, hover:bg-ink hover:text-cream) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold. Then a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of 5 .card-hover articles, each rounded-[2rem] overflow-hidden p-7 min-h-[320px] flex-col justify-between with a top row (a small rounded-full category chip + a ph:arrow-up-right-bold that fades in on group-hover), a big centered Phosphor illustration glyph (~88px), and a title + subtitle: card 1 bg-coral text-cream (Branding, ph:bird-fill, 'Plume & Co.'), card 2 bg-sunny text-ink (Web Design, ph:ice-cream-fill, 'Scoop Studio'), card 3 bg-teal text-cream (Product UI, ph:device-mobile-camera-fill, 'Nimbus App'), card 4 a WIDE sm:col-span-2 bg-ink text-cream min-h-[240px] campaign card with left copy ('Bloom Festival') + an absolute spin-slow bg-coral/30 .blob1 + a big sunny ph:flower-lotus-fill, and card 5 bg-cream border-2 border-ink (Illustration, coral ph:smiley-fill, 'Doodle Pack'). Colored cards carry soft colored glow shadows.

### Services trio
Section id=services, relative py-20 -> lg:py-28 with a tinted bg-teal/8 and a small floating bg-sunny/40 .blob2 top-right. Centered header (max-w-2xl mx-auto): a teal uppercase eyebrow 'What we do' + H2 'Three things, done really well.'. Then a grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-7 items-start of three .card-hover cards: service 1 = rounded-[2rem] bg-cream border-2 border-ink p-8 with a w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-coral text-cream icon chip (ph:pen-nib-fill) carrying shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d], an H3 'Brand & Identity', a body line, and a 2-item check list (coral ph:check-circle-fill); service 2 = the FEATURED card bg-ink text-cream p-8 md:-translate-y-4 (raised) with a sunny icon chip (ph:browsers-fill, no hard shadow), 'Website Design', and sunny check marks; service 3 = bg-cream border-2 border-ink with a teal chip (ph:squares-four-fill, hard shadow), 'Product Design', teal checks.

### Client logo row
Section id=clients, py-16 -> lg:py-20, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. A centered muted line 'Trusted by playful teams big and small' (text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink/45), then a flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-12 gap-y-8 text-ink/55 row of six faux-client lockups, each a flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-extrabold = a Phosphor fill glyph tinted coral/teal/sunny + a wordmark: ph:planet-fill Orbit, ph:leaf-fill Fernly, ph:sun-fill Daylight, ph:heart-fill Kindred, ph:cloud-fill Nimbus, ph:cube-fill Blocky.

### Coral CTA panel
Section id=contact, pb-24 -> lg:pb-32, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. A relative overflow-hidden rounded-[2.5rem] bg-coral text-cream panel, px-8 py-16 -> lg:px-16 lg:py-20, text-center. A pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 layer of floating shapes (a sunny/40 .blob1 floaty top-left, a teal/40 .blob2 floaty-slow bottom-right, a dashed cream/40 rounded-full spin-slow). Centered content (relative z-10 max-w-2xl mx-auto): a rounded-full pill eyebrow (bg-cream/15) with a ph:coffee-fill + 'Lets grab a coffee'; an H2 'Got a fun idea? Lets make it real.' (text-[clamp(2.2rem,5.5vw,4rem)] font-extrabold); a soft cream/85 subline; and a button row (flex-wrap justify-center gap-4): a dark ink primary pill 'hi@studiomarmalade.co' with a hard offset shadow shadow-[0_8px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)] that presses on hover and a ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, plus a cream 'Book a call' pill (hover:bg-sunny) with a ph:phone-call-fill.

### Footer (dark, 4-column)
A bg-ink text-cream footer, pt-16 pb-10, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. A grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-10 pb-12 with a bottom border-cream/10: first block md:col-span-5 = the brand lockup (coral rounded-2xl ph:sparkle-fill chip + 'Studio Marmalade' wordmark), a max-w-xs cream/60 blurb, and a row of four social circles (w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-cream/10 hover:bg-coral) with ph:instagram-logo-fill / ph:dribbble-logo-fill / ph:x-logo-fill / ph:linkedin-logo-fill; then two link columns ('Studio' md:col-span-2 md:col-start-7, 'Resources' md:col-span-2) each an uppercase cream/45 heading + a space-y-3 list of cream/75 links that hover:text-coral; and a 'Say hi' md:col-span-3 column with an email + 'Lisbon · Remote-first'. Below the border: a pt-8 flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between row (text-[13px] cream/45) with a copyright line '© 2026 Studio Marmalade. Made with care & coffee.' and Privacy / Terms links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Chunky hard-offset drop-shadow (the brand signature) — A solid, un-blurred offset shadow in ink under primary buttons, the logo square, and icon chips, that collapses as the element nudges down on hover, giving the whole page a tactile, sticker-like, pressable feel. This is the single most recognizable craft detail of the design.
Apply shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#23201d] to the coral primary button and the coral logo square (use the smaller shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d] on the w-16 service icon chips), and on hover set hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#23201d] with a transition-all so the button visibly presses down by 4px. On the dark CTA primary button use the same effect tinted to the panel: shadow-[0_8px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)] -> hover shadow-[0_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)]. Never blur this shadow; the hard 0-blur offset is the point.

### Organic floating blob shapes — Soft pastel organic shapes (lopsided border-radius) that float and slowly spin in the hero and CTA backgrounds, plus a spinning blob behind the wide campaign card, supplying the warm, hand-made energy without any imagery.
Define .blob1 { border-radius:46% 54% 62% 38% / 54% 42% 58% 46% } and .blob2 { border-radius:60% 40% 33% 67% / 50% 56% 44% 50% }, plus a tailwind borderRadius blob token of the .blob1 value. Place them as pointer-events-none absolute elements with translucent fills (bg-sunny/45, bg-teal/35, bg-coral/30) at various sizes (w-72/w-40/w-28/w-24 etc) and animate them with .floaty (7s), .floaty-slow (10s), and .spin-slow (22s). Pair with small spin-slow dashed-border rounded-full rings and tiny solid coral dots. Keep body overflow-x-hidden so they never create horizontal scroll.

### Hand-drawn underline squiggle on the hero accent word — An imperfect, marker-style sunny underline swooshed under the coral word 'smile' in the hero headline, signalling the friendly, illustrative brand voice.
Wrap the accent word in a relative inline-block span (text-coral, z-10) and place an absolute -bottom-2 left-0 w-full inline SVG (height ~18, viewBox '0 0 220 18') with a single hand-drawn <path d='M3 13C56 5 165 4 217 9'> stroked in #ffc23c (sunny), stroke-width 7, stroke-linecap round, fill none, so it reads as a quick marker swoosh beneath the word.

### Infinite service marquee with outline stroke-text — A dark full-bleed band that scrolls the studio's services horizontally forever, alternating solid cream words with hollow outline-only words and colored asterisk separators, used as a rhythmic divider between the hero and the work grid.
Define @keyframes marquee { from{transform:translateX(0)} to{transform:translateX(-50%)} } applied to a .marquee-track flex w-max (26s linear infinite) that holds TWO identical word groups (second aria-hidden) so the -50% loop is seamless. Words at text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold; render alternating words with .stroke-text { -webkit-text-stroke:2px #fdf9f3; color:transparent } so they appear as cream outlines; separate words with ph:asterisk-bold icons tinted sunny/coral/teal.

### Floating bento stat collage — The hero's right column: a small grid of rounded color-blocked stat cards (teal/sunny/coral) that gently bob out of phase, topped by a rotated circular '100% human' sticker badge, standing in for a hero product image.
A relative grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 of rounded-[2rem] p-7 h-44 cards, each flex-col justify-between with a Phosphor fill icon at top and a label + big text-4xl font-extrabold stat at bottom: a full-width col-span-2 bg-teal text-cream card (240+ projects, soft teal glow shadow), a bg-sunny text-ink card (4.9 rating), and a bg-coral text-cream card (9 yrs, soft coral glow). Give each card .floaty or .floaty-slow so they bob out of sync. Overlay an absolute -top-7 -right-3 rotate-6 w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-cream border-2 border-ink .floaty badge with centered '100% human' micro-copy.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive playful agency marketing homepage (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1180px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8; the hero is a lg:grid-cols-12 split (copy col-span-7, bento collage col-span-5) that stacks below lg; the marquee is a full-bleed duplicated track; the project grid is sm:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 with one wide sm:col-span-2 card; the services trio is md:grid-cols-3 with the middle card raised via md:-translate-y-4 only at md+; the footer is md:grid-cols-12; nav links hide below md (hamburger appears) and the 'Start a project' pill hides below sm; body is overflow-x-hidden so the absolutely-positioned floating blobs and the rotated badge never cause horizontal scroll. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom colors (cream #fdf9f3, coral #ff7a59, teal #2bb6a3, sunny #ffc23c, ink #23201d), the Poppins font family, and a blob borderRadius token; Google Fonts loads Poppins 400-900; icons + illustrative spots are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*-fill) glyphs from the Iconify CDN. All copy and the 'Studio Marmalade' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the warm playful pastel palette (cream canvas + coral/teal/sunny trio on near-black ink #23201d, strictly no blue/purple/gradient-slop) and the friendly-maximalist craft system (chunky hard-offset ink drop-shadows that press on hover, organic floating blob shapes with floaty/spin animations, a hand-drawn underline squiggle on the hero accent word, an infinite service marquee with outline stroke-text, and a floating bento stat collage), applied to a standard agency layout (sticky glass nav -> split hero -> service marquee -> colorful work grid -> services trio -> client logo row -> big coral CTA panel -> 4-column dark footer), NOT the specific studio.

style.description: Friendly, playful, warm-maximalist agency aesthetic built on a soft cream canvas with a bold coral / teal / sunny-yellow trio anchored by a near-black ink. Type is Poppins throughout at heavy weights (extrabold/black) with tight tracking for display and a muted ink/65-70 for body. Iconify Phosphor fill glyphs (ph:*-fill) supply all icons and the playful illustrative spots (paint brush, ice cream, bird, flower, smiley).

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, frameless responsive marketing page on a cream canvas. Almost every section centers inside mx-auto max-w-[1180px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8 padding. Order top to bottom: a sticky glassy cream nav; a two-column hero (left copy lg:col-span-7, right floating bento collage lg:col-span-5) sitting over absolutely-positioned floating blob shapes; a full-bleed dark ink marquee statement strip of service words; a project grid (sm:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 with one wide sm:col-span-2 card); a tinted-teal services trio (md:grid-cols-3, middle card raised); a centered wrap of client logo lockups; a big coral rounded CTA panel with floating blobs; and a dark four-column footer. Reflow: nav links hide below md (a hamburger button shows) and the 'Start a project' pill hides below sm; the hero grid is lg:grid-cols-12 that stacks to one column below lg with the collage dropping below the copy; the marquee is a duplicated track for a seamless loop; the project grid goes 1 -> 2 -> 3 columns with the wide card spanning 2; the services trio goes 1 -> 3 columns and the middle card's md:-translate-y-4 raise only applies at md+; the footer is md:grid-cols-12 that collapses to stacked columns; the bottom legal row is flex-col -> sm:flex-row. body is overflow-x-hidden so floating blobs and the rotated badge never trigger horizontal scroll.

Inside: mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8, h-[74px], flex row items-center justify-between. Left = brand lockup: a relative grid place-items-center w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-coral text-cream chip holding a ph:sparkle-fill (20px) with the signature hard shadow shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d], beside the wordmark 'Studio' + 'Marmalade' (the second word in text-coral), text-[19px] font-extrabold tracking-tight. Center (hidden md:flex, gap-9, text-[15px] font-medium text-ink/70): Work / Services / Clients / Contact, each hover:text-ink. Right: a 'Start a project' pill (hidden sm:inline-flex, px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-ink text-cream text-[14px] font-semibold, hover:bg-coral) with a trailing ph:arrow-up-right-bold; plus a md:hidden hamburger button (grid place-items-center w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-ink/5 with a ph:list-bold).

A relative overflow-hidden section. Behind everything, a pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 layer of floating shapes: a w-72 h-72 bg-sunny/45 .blob1 floaty-slow top-left, a w-40 h-40 bg-teal/35 .blob2 floaty top-right, a w-16 h-16 dashed-border-coral/50 rounded-full spin-slow bottom-left, and a small w-6 h-6 bg-coral dot floaty. Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8 pt-16 pb-20 -> lg:pt-24 lg:pb-28, a grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center. Left (lg:col-span-7): a rounded-full pill eyebrow (bg-teal/15 text-teal text-[13px] font-semibold) with a ph:hand-waving-fill + 'A friendly design studio'; an H1 font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[0.98] text-[clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5.3rem)] reading 'We make brands people actually smile about.' where 'smile' is a relative inline-block text-coral with an absolute hand-drawn SVG squiggle underline (stroke #ffc23c, stroke-width 7, stroke-linecap round); a max-w-[30rem] text-ink/65 lead; a button row: a coral primary 'See our work' button (px-7 py-4 rounded-full bg-coral text-cream font-semibold, shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#23201d], hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#23201d]) with a ph:arrow-down-bold, plus an outlined 'Say hello' button (bg-cream border-2 border-ink rounded-full, hover:bg-sunny) with a ph:play-circle-fill; then a social-proof row of three overlapping -space-x-3 w-10 h-10 rounded-full avatars (coral/teal/sunny with border-[3px] border-cream and initials) + 'Loved by 120+ founders & product teams worldwide.'. Right (lg:col-span-5, relative): a grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 bento of floating stat cards, each rounded-[2rem] p-7 flex-col justify-between h-44: a full-width col-span-2 teal card (ph:paint-brush-broad-fill, 'Projects shipped 240+', soft teal glow shadow), a sunny card (ph:cursor-click-fill, 'Avg. rating 4.9 stars'), and a coral card (ph:rocket-launch-fill, 'Yrs of craft 9', soft coral glow); plus an absolute -top-7 -right-3 rotate-6 w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-cream border-2 border-ink floaty badge reading '100% human'. All three cards carry .floaty/.floaty-slow.

A full-bleed bg-ink text-cream py-7 band with an overflow-hidden inner. A .marquee-track flex w-max items-center gap-10 (animation 26s linear infinite) containing TWO identical flex groups (the second aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Each group: the words Branding / Web Design / Product UI / Illustration / Motion at text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap, separated by ph:asterisk-bold icons tinted alternately sunny/coral/teal, with 'Web Design' and 'Illustration' rendered as .stroke-text (transparent fill, 2px cream text-stroke) for contrast against the solid words.

Section id=work, py-20 -> lg:py-28, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. Header row (flex-wrap items-end justify-between): left = a coral uppercase eyebrow 'Now highlights' + an H2 'Recent work we're proud of.'; right = an outlined 'View all projects' pill (border-2 border-ink, hover:bg-ink hover:text-cream) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold. Then a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of 5 .card-hover articles, each rounded-[2rem] overflow-hidden p-7 min-h-[320px] flex-col justify-between with a top row (a small rounded-full category chip + a ph:arrow-up-right-bold that fades in on group-hover), a big centered Phosphor illustration glyph (~88px), and a title + subtitle: card 1 bg-coral text-cream (Branding, ph:bird-fill, 'Plume & Co.'), card 2 bg-sunny text-ink (Web Design, ph:ice-cream-fill, 'Scoop Studio'), card 3 bg-teal text-cream (Product UI, ph:device-mobile-camera-fill, 'Nimbus App'), card 4 a WIDE sm:col-span-2 bg-ink text-cream min-h-[240px] campaign card with left copy ('Bloom Festival') + an absolute spin-slow bg-coral/30 .blob1 + a big sunny ph:flower-lotus-fill, and card 5 bg-cream border-2 border-ink (Illustration, coral ph:smiley-fill, 'Doodle Pack'). Colored cards carry soft colored glow shadows.

Section id=services, relative py-20 -> lg:py-28 with a tinted bg-teal/8 and a small floating bg-sunny/40 .blob2 top-right. Centered header (max-w-2xl mx-auto): a teal uppercase eyebrow 'What we do' + H2 'Three things, done really well.'. Then a grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-7 items-start of three .card-hover cards: service 1 = rounded-[2rem] bg-cream border-2 border-ink p-8 with a w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-coral text-cream icon chip (ph:pen-nib-fill) carrying shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d], an H3 'Brand & Identity', a body line, and a 2-item check list (coral ph:check-circle-fill); service 2 = the FEATURED card bg-ink text-cream p-8 md:-translate-y-4 (raised) with a sunny icon chip (ph:browsers-fill, no hard shadow), 'Website Design', and sunny check marks; service 3 = bg-cream border-2 border-ink with a teal chip (ph:squares-four-fill, hard shadow), 'Product Design', teal checks.

Section id=clients, py-16 -> lg:py-20, mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 -> lg:px-8. A centered muted line 'Trusted by playful teams big and small' (text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink/45), then a flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-12 gap-y-8 text-ink/55 row of six faux-client lockups, each a flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-extrabold = a Phosphor fill glyph tinted coral/teal/sunny + a wordmark: ph:planet-fill Orbit, ph:leaf-fill Fernly, ph:sun-fill Daylight, ph:heart-fill Kindred, ph:cloud-fill Nimbus, ph:cube-fill Blocky.

special_ui_components.description: A solid, un-blurred offset shadow in ink under primary buttons, the logo square, and icon chips, that collapses as the element nudges down on hover, giving the whole page a tactile, sticker-like, pressable feel. This is the single most recognizable craft detail of the design.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#23201d] to the coral primary button and the coral logo square (use the smaller shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#23201d] on the w-16 service icon chips), and on hover set hover:translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#23201d] with a transition-all so the button visibly presses down by 4px. On the dark CTA primary button use the same effect tinted to the panel: shadow-[0_8px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)] -> hover shadow-[0_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,.25)]. Never blur this shadow; the hard 0-blur offset is the point.

special_ui_components.description: Soft pastel organic shapes (lopsided border-radius) that float and slowly spin in the hero and CTA backgrounds, plus a spinning blob behind the wide campaign card, supplying the warm, hand-made energy without any imagery.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .blob1 { border-radius:46% 54% 62% 38% / 54% 42% 58% 46% } and .blob2 { border-radius:60% 40% 33% 67% / 50% 56% 44% 50% }, plus a tailwind borderRadius blob token of the .blob1 value. Place them as pointer-events-none absolute elements with translucent fills (bg-sunny/45, bg-teal/35, bg-coral/30) at various sizes (w-72/w-40/w-28/w-24 etc) and animate them with .floaty (7s), .floaty-slow (10s), and .spin-slow (22s). Pair with small spin-slow dashed-border rounded-full rings and tiny solid coral dots. Keep body overflow-x-hidden so they never create horizontal scroll.

special_ui_components.component: Hand-drawn underline squiggle on the hero accent word
special_ui_components.description: An imperfect, marker-style sunny underline swooshed under the coral word 'smile' in the hero headline, signalling the friendly, illustrative brand voice.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap the accent word in a relative inline-block span (text-coral, z-10) and place an absolute -bottom-2 left-0 w-full inline SVG (height ~18, viewBox '0 0 220 18') with a single hand-drawn <path d='M3 13C56 5 165 4 217 9'> stroked in #ffc23c (sunny), stroke-width 7, stroke-linecap round, fill none, so it reads as a quick marker swoosh beneath the word.

special_ui_components.component: Infinite service marquee with outline stroke-text
special_ui_components.description: A dark full-bleed band that scrolls the studio's services horizontally forever, alternating solid cream words with hollow outline-only words and colored asterisk separators, used as a rhythmic divider between the hero and the work grid.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define @keyframes marquee { from{transform:translateX(0)} to{transform:translateX(-50%)} } applied to a .marquee-track flex w-max (26s linear infinite) that holds TWO identical word groups (second aria-hidden) so the -50% loop is seamless. Words at text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold; render alternating words with .stroke-text { -webkit-text-stroke:2px #fdf9f3; color:transparent } so they appear as cream outlines; separate words with ph:asterisk-bold icons tinted sunny/coral/teal.

special_ui_components.description: The hero's right column: a small grid of rounded color-blocked stat cards (teal/sunny/coral) that gently bob out of phase, topped by a rotated circular '100% human' sticker badge, standing in for a hero product image.
special_ui_components.prompt: A relative grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 of rounded-[2rem] p-7 h-44 cards, each flex-col justify-between with a Phosphor fill icon at top and a label + big text-4xl font-extrabold stat at bottom: a full-width col-span-2 bg-teal text-cream card (240+ projects, soft teal glow shadow), a bg-sunny text-ink card (4.9 rating), and a bg-coral text-cream card (9 yrs, soft coral glow). Give each card .floaty or .floaty-slow so they bob out of sync. Overlay an absolute -top-7 -right-3 rotate-6 w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-cream border-2 border-ink .floaty badge with centered '100% human' micro-copy.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive playful agency marketing homepage (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1180px] with px-6 -> lg:px-8; the hero is a lg:grid-cols-12 split (copy col-span-7, bento collage col-span-5) that stacks below lg; the marquee is a full-bleed duplicated track; the project grid is sm:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 with one wide sm:col-span-2 card; the services trio is md:grid-cols-3 with the middle card raised via md:-translate-y-4 only at md+; the footer is md:grid-cols-12; nav links hide below md (hamburger appears) and the 'Start a project' pill hides below sm; body is overflow-x-hidden so the absolutely-positioned floating blobs and the rotated badge never cause horizontal scroll. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the custom colors (cream #fdf9f3, coral #ff7a59, teal #2bb6a3, sunny #ffc23c, ink #23201d), the Poppins font family, and a blob borderRadius token; Google Fonts loads Poppins 400-900; icons + illustrative spots are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*-fill) glyphs from the Iconify CDN. All copy and the 'Studio Marmalade' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the warm playful pastel palette (cream canvas + coral/teal/sunny trio on near-black ink #23201d, strictly no blue/purple/gradient-slop) and the friendly-maximalist craft system (chunky hard-offset ink drop-shadows that press on hover, organic floating blob shapes with floaty/spin animations, a hand-drawn underline squiggle on the hero accent word, an infinite service marquee with outline stroke-text, and a floating bento stat collage), applied to a standard agency layout (sticky glass nav -> split hero -> service marquee -> colorful work grid -> services trio -> client logo row -> big coral CTA panel -> 4-column dark footer), NOT the specific studio.
